synth.notes:
BLOCK mode: ACTION1/2 move both cyan blocks up/down by 4; ACTION3/4 move them mirrored (apart/together), each independently blocked by half/board bounds, markers, the other block and hidden wall cells.
Click a marker -> ARMED mode (blocks become color_1 players, marker color_11 active); ACTION1-4 move the active marker; click another marker switches; click a player -> back to BLOCK mode; ACTION5 no-op.
Top/bottom color_0 bars width = floor(3(n+1)/7), n = actions since level start, tracked as continuity-gated hidden state (fallback: smallest n consistent with bar width).
Names: block_left/right take indices 0,1; all others type_color_idx ranked by (y,x).
Unconfirmed: 3 blocked moves have no visible cause; modeled as hidden maze cells HIDDEN_WALL_CELLS (walls have no pixels), level-specific.
